definitions.explanation: The act of passing another vehicle while driving; moving ahead of someone or something that was in front.

examples.japanese: {追|お}い{越|こ}し{禁止|きんし}です。
{危険|きけん}な{追|お}い{越|こ}しをした。
{追|お}い{越|こ}し{車線|しゃせん}は{右側|みぎがわ}にある。
examples.english: The passing lane is on the right side.

notes:
{追|お}い{越|こ}し is the noun form of the verb {追|お}い{越|こ}す (to overtake, to pass).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{禁止|きんし}: no passing, overtaking prohibited
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{車線|しゃせん}: passing lane
- {追|お}い{越|こ}しをする: to overtake
- {危険|きけん}な{追|お}い{越|こ}し: dangerous overtaking

TRAFFIC RULES:
- In Japan, vehicles drive on the left, so passing lanes are on the right
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{禁止|きんし} signs indicate zones where overtaking is not allowed
